doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Writing down addresses, Al Morgan and Dauphine Street
summary: Addresses are exchanged amid noise; Pasley says he is leaving town the next night.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
